knife_edges.confidence: HIGH for mechanism; MEDIUM for exact taste-optimal correction
knife_edges.primary_cause: Explicit source-coordinate polyline subtraction/intersection/replacement replaces organic source terminals with mathematically straight diagonal planes and sharp corners. The builder poly() uses lineTo for every edge. There are 17 cuts, 3 intersections, and a four-point short-knife reconstruction.
amplifiers: Thresholding A>=200 and flattening RGB removes partial-alpha edge modulation and source shade.
VTracer spline approximation plus anisotropic mapping compresses the already binary silhouette.
knife_edges.counterevidence: Some source edges were smooth and inflated; reverting every cut to the guide would also revert successful S4 shape changes. Straight planes exist in the reference too; absence of every straight line is not the objective.
knife_edges.not_supported: No evidence that adding random noise, more holes, or a new image-generation call is necessary. Interior hole counts cannot judge exterior edge quality.

minimum_implementation_spec.stop_condition: One sibling local repair, full and 480px pixel review against S4 and canonical reference. If any frozen dimension regresses or the two complaints persist, keep reasoning open; return raw failed pixels to DEEP. Do not launch another style or formal production until parent accepts this local repair.

falsifiable_predictions: Changing only the two left x-coordinates of XIAN_UPPER_BAR_END will remove the dark hairline and detached cap without moving orange or any neighboring glyph. Failure falsifies the proposed join implementation and requires actual contour inspection.
The complaint about edges should visibly improve after softening only artificial cut-face joins; changing grain count alone should leave the ruler-straight silhouettes visibly unchanged.
Removing all cut operations should make source-like rounded terminals return but also change S4 shape/mass; this is evidence against broad rollback as the minimal solution.
The Xian lower-left leg channel should remain visible after upper-horizontal repair; if it disappears, repair scope escaped the diagnosed defect.
remaining_uncertainty: Human feedback names Xian without marking a location. The upper-bar split is an unambiguous defect matching the description; user could additionally dislike the existing lower-leg separation. Do not fill the latter without pixel review showing a readability issue.
Taste-optimal edge curvature cannot be selected by raw counts. Proposed scale must be evaluated at 100% and 480px against reference.
